arguments.Title: 자동 운행 초기화 객체 확인
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using InhaExpress.Client.MapClient; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { foreach(var map in Object.FindObjectsByType<CampusServerMap>(FindObjectsInactive.Include,FindObjectsSortMode.None)) { result.Log("map="+map.name+" active="+map.gameObject.activeInHierarchy+" enabled="+map.enabled+" markers="+map.markers.Length);for(var t=map.transform;t!=null;t=t.parent)result.Log("parent="+t.name+" self="+t.gameObject.activeSelf); } } }
